accounts.ask.title: Ask before running a changed harness
accounts.ask.description: wisp keeps the path, size and sha256 of each harness’s program from the first time it runs it. Off, a change shows on the task and here. On, a run on a changed harness waits until you trust it

accounts.lean.title: Lean Claude Code runs
accounts.lean.description: Without telemetry, error reports and update checks: fewer connections and about a second faster to start. A lean run has no claude.ai connectors (Google Drive, Docs, …), no org memory (Team plans), no /ultrareview or /advisor, no push notifications, and none of Claude Code’s server-rolled features. wisp’s side runs (judges, reviews, the retro) need none of these
